meta.title: Arboretum Green Hotel · Huye, Rwanda
meta.description: A quiet garden hotel on the Huye–Tumba road. Rooms, restaurant, bar, coffee and a hall for gatherings.

home.heroText: A garden hotel on the Huye–Tumba road. Quiet rooms, a warm table and room to gather.
home.introTitle: Comfort, nature and a quiet kind of excellence.
home.introText: Arboretum Green Hotel takes its name from the old arboretum that shades Huye. We keep its pace: unhurried mornings, honest food, rooms that let you sleep.

doors.stay: Four room types, each calm and carefully kept.
doors.dine: Restaurant, bar and coffee bar, from first light to late.
doors.meet: A hall for conferences, weddings and family occasions.
doors.discover: Arboretum walks, the museum, Nyungwe by day.

home.eveningTitle: When the lights come on, the garden goes quiet.
home.eveningText: Dinner under the slatted ceiling, a drink at the bar, a last coffee on the terrace.
home.contactText: Write on WhatsApp or call. A person at reception answers, not a machine.

stay.title: Rooms to rest in.
stay.text: Four kinds of room, all with private bathrooms, fresh linen every day and quiet nights.

dine.title: A warm table, morning to night.
dine.text: Three rooms under one roof: a restaurant for long meals, a bar for the evening, a coffee bar for the morning.
dine.kitchenText: Everything leaves a kitchen we would be happy to show you. Tell us about allergies or preferences when you book.

meet.title: Room to gather.
meet.text: Conferences, weddings, graduations and family occasions, hosted with the same care as a single guest.
meet.quoteText: Share the date, the number of guests and what you need. We will send a proposal within one working day.

discover.title: Stay a day longer.
discover.text: Huye is Rwanda's university town and its cultural heart. These are the places our guests ask about most.
discover.nameText: Just across town, the Ruhande Arboretum has grown since 1933. Its calm is the feeling we want every guest to find here.

contact.title: Book & contact.
contact.text: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. Calls are welcome around the clock.
contact.formText: For stays, events or dining. We reply by phone or email.
contact.name: Full name
contact.sent: Thank you. Your enquiry has reached reception and we will reply shortly.
contact.failed: We could not send this right now. Please write to us on WhatsApp or call instead.
contact.required: Please add your name and a phone number.
